plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) C3, the category against the requester's rule: no instrument reads the category or the rule, so a wrong category would go unseen. (2) C5, reads of only the approved accounts: scope of a call is not in a plan, and at 10 per line for 101 reads it cannot be covered by the 50 allowance; at most about 5 reads can be sampled during the work. (3) C10, a notice in the outbox for every sending call: sent as released reports only confirmations, and trace of a call is not in a plan and at 10 per line cannot cover 100 sends from the 50 allowance; at most about 5 can be sampled at A3. (4) The summary and same set read the staged set, not the live tables; live equality rests on the promotion line's fp_in/fp_out, and the undo rehearsal holds only for one hour and only if the promotion starts from the state it ran on. (5) The plan leaves 20 units unused under its 200 ceiling; nothing in the library at that price would have closed C3, C5 or C10.
